title: traffic sign v1 names
description: A sign's names in skifahrer/traffic-signs: `signs/<category>/<sign>/<sign>.json`, shared by every country that has the sign. One key per language, `en` first.

$schema.description: The schema the file follows: this schema's $id.

en.description: The English name every country with the sign shares.

$comment: Keys are ISO 639-1 codes (`sk`, `cs`). When two countries name a sign differently in one language, the second adds its region: `de` for Germany, `de-AT` for Austria; English-speaking countries keep their wording under `en-GB`, `en-US`, and a region of a country under `en-US-CA`.
